title: unified-surface-pivots-dashboard-rollout-cost-lenses
creator: Olivia Chen
description: Rethink the Redwood Console surface model to reduce cognitive load across dashboards, rollout controls, and cost breakdowns. Goal: create a compact set of "lenses" (Dashboard, Deploy Rollouts, Cost Insights) that share a consistent left-rail affordance and contextual workspace switcher so users can move between environments and views without losing state. Deliverables: annotated IA map, high-fidelity rail prototypes for desktop and wide-tablet, component spec for workspace switcher, and a short usability report with recommended trade-offs for rollout controls in constrained layouts.
acceptance_criteria: Left rail supports persistent primary nav + contextual lens toggle with keyboard access
Workspace switcher preserves route state for dashboard filters and rollout canaries when switching workspaces
Cost Insights includes token-level and model-level drilldowns accessible from the same rail without a new top-level nav
Prototype validated in 6 unmoderated tasks with 80% success rate or higher on navigational tasks
Engineering has a component spec and responsive CSS tokens to implement the rail and switcher
comments: 2025-02-12 - Olivia Chen: Kickoff — scoped three lenses (Dashboard, Rollouts, Cost Insights). Initial IA sketch attached. Noted overlap between Rollouts and Dashboard traces; proposing collapsible rollout mini-canvas.
2025-02-18 - Aisha Patel: Proto 1 uploaded. Feedback: workspace switcher currently clears dashboard filters — need to preserve filter state and surface a 'return' breadcrumb.
2025-02-21 - Marcus Lee: PM review — emphasize runbooks and canary controls in Rollouts lens; add an 'abort' affordance near live traces. Prioritize latency of switching for Dedicated customers.

2025-02-25 - Samuel Rivera: Eng review — rails must be implemented with progressive enhancement; suggested ARIA roles and a11y keyboard traps to support keyboard-only flows. Raised concern about token-cost drilldown heavy queries; asked to add a caching UX guideline.

2025-02-28 - Usability session 1: 6 participants (mix of ML engineers and platform PMs). Observations: users found lens toggle discoverable but expected direct 'view cost by model' from dashboard items. Action: add model-context menu linking into Cost Insights.
2025-03-01 - Aisha Patel: Proto 2 uploaded with preserved filter state and inline model context linking. Also added compact rollout summary card to dashboard canvas.

2025-03-03 - Rina Sato: Design review — approve IA direction; requested design tokens locked and a short handoff checklist for Eng. Recommended a small beta with Dedicated customers before wide rollout.
decision_log: Use a single persistent left rail that hosts both global nav and a compact lens toggle (icons + labels on hover)
Workspace switcher preserves per-workspace route state and exposes a 'restore last state' option on switch
Compact rollout mini-canvas should live as an overlay on Dashboard lens for fast checks and full Rollouts lens for management
Cost Insights will reuse dashboard metrics components with an added pivot to token-level and model-level views instead of duplicating charts
Accessibility: keyboard-first interactions and screen reader labels are required for the switcher and lens toggles
next_steps: Lock design tokens and produce a handoff PDF for Engineering (due 2025-03-07)
Schedule 2-hour dev sync to align on caching expectations and API endpoints for cost drilldowns (owner: Samuel Rivera)
Prepare beta plan and identify 3 Dedicated customers for opt-in (owner: Marcus Lee)
Run Accessibility audit on Prototype 2 and fix any high-severity issues (owner: Diego Alvarez)
Ship 'state-preserve' spec to ENG for iteration in runtime-1.20 milestone
